# reco Provider

Manage Reco configuration as code. Authenticate with a Reco API key and your tenant base URL, either in the provider block or through the RECO_API_KEY and RECO_BASE_URL environment variables.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    reco = {
      source  = "recolabs/reco"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "reco" {
  api_key  = var.reco_api_key
  base_url = var.reco_base_url
}

variable "reco_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "reco_base_url" {
  type = string
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Reco API key. Create one in the Reco platform under Settings → API Keys. May also be set via the RECO_API_KEY environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Base URL of your Reco tenant, the same URL you use to sign in to the Reco platform. Must use https. May also be set via the RECO_BASE_URL environment variable.
